_about: Public-domain A. H. Tuttle, Methodist Episcopal minister, for the Word Hoard: The Safety of Our Young Men, The Living Word, Nathan Bangs, Egypt to Canaan (lectures on the spiritual meanings of the Exodus), and his history of the Roseville Methodist Episcopal Church. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 122 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.
